constants.description: Percent added to the attacker's effective strength per veteran/condition tier step (clamped to one step; tied to the 'Veteran +50%' debug string)
constants.name: veteran-tier-bonus-attacker

constants.description: Same as veteran-tier-bonus-attacker, applied on the defender's side
constants.name: veteran-tier-bonus-defender

constants.description: Percent added to the defender's effective strength when defending in a friendly city tile (tied to the 'Fortified +100%' debug string)
constants.name: fortified-in-city-bonus

constants.description: Percent added to the defender's effective strength while actively fortifying (tied to the 'Fortifying +50%' debug string)
constants.name: fortifying-bonus

constants.description: Percent subtracted from the attacker's effective strength when one of four directional per-tile bit-combination checks matches (pattern consistent with a zone-of-control/flanking penalty; no debug string confirms the exact trigger name)
constants.name: zone-of-control-penalty

constants.description: Multiplier applied to the defender's effective strength for an auto-resolve/overwhelming-force threshold check, used when a per-civilization difficulty byte equals the current global difficulty value
constants.name: overwhelm-threshold-primary-match

constants.description: Same threshold check as overwhelm-threshold-primary-match, used when the difficulty byte does not match
constants.name: overwhelm-threshold-primary-mismatch

constants.description: Multiplier for a second, separate auto-resolve threshold check earlier in the same function, used when a related civilization comparison matches
constants.name: overwhelm-threshold-secondary-match

constants.description: Same check as overwhelm-threshold-secondary-match, used when the comparison does not match
constants.name: overwhelm-threshold-secondary-mismatch

constants.description: A third variant of the same auto-resolve threshold pattern, used when a further condition matches
constants.name: overwhelm-threshold-tertiary-match

constants.description: Same check as overwhelm-threshold-tertiary-match, used when the condition does not match
constants.name: overwhelm-threshold-tertiary-mismatch
